scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check on the status of my application. Could you please tell me if it has been approved, denied, or if it's still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and originated.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Could you please tell me what my interest rate is and the total costs of this loan? Also, I'd like to know if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan.
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 6.750%. The total costs of this loan are $12,821.84. This is not a high-cost mortgage and there are no negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Could you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? And what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has been sold to Ginnie Mae. You were approved for an FHA:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Got it. Lastly, what is my debt-to-income ratio and what does that mean for my application?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is 38%. This ratio compares your monthly debt payments to your monthly income. Lenders use this to assess your ability to manage monthly payments.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for all the information. It's been very helpful.

<Neutral> - The agent provided all the information I asked for, but I was hoping for a lower interest rate.
